$comment: Zone settings that make the Cloudflare proxy safe in front of GitHub
Pages for this app. Values are PATCHed one setting at a time via
Two of these are correctness, not preference:
ssl=strict        Flexible terminates TLS at the edge and speaks plain
HTTP to Pages, which redirects back to HTTPS - the
classic redirect loop, on every page.
rocket_loader=off Email obfuscation and Rocket Loader rewrite markup and
defer scripts; both break a client-side routed app.

settings.why: Pages serves a valid Let's Encrypt cert; Flexible would loop against its HTTPS redirect.
One canonical scheme at the edge, matching the origin's own redirect.
No mixed-content surprises for the few absolute links in static HTML.
Modern floor; the Pages origin already requires TLS 1.2+.
Default on new zones; pinned so a settings drift is visible in review.
Free win for the relay-heavy surfaces.
The bundles are large; the origin does not compress at the edge.
Rewrites <script> loading order and breaks the SPA bootstrap.
Rewrites markup and injects script; unsafe for a client-rendered app.
Mobile image rewriting has no benefit for app bundles and can break SVG.
Image transcoding would alter hashed asset bytes under an immutable TTL.
Cache static extensions only; the ruleset above owns the real policy.
Fallback browser TTL for responses the ruleset does not cover.
